dataset.citation: Moreno-Sandoval et al. (2026), The Financial Document Causality Detection Shared Task (FinCausal 2026), FNP@LREC 2026.
dataset.format: CSV ';'-separated: id;context;question;answer (train). Test has no answer column (gold withheld by organisers).
dataset.corpus_note: Controlled retrieval corpus constructed for this project: every evaluated case's own context plus 200 distractor contexts from the other internal split. FinCausal is an extractive QA dataset, not a native document-retrieval benchmark.
dataset.split_note: dev_internal = deterministic ~20% hash split of the official training file (the official test gold is not public).
dataset.multi_step_note: The released CSV does not mark multi-step chains; the subgroup flag (>=2 causal connectives in the gold context) is a heuristic computed in the evaluation layer only.
